name: epubcheck-standalone-cli
description: The official EPUBCheck command line with no Java to install: same flags, console output, JSON, XML, and XMP reports, and exit codes as the official tool, byte-identical, run straight from npx.

scripts.//build: A clean Rolldown build emits publishable JavaScript plus bundled declarations and declaration maps from src/; chmod preserves the npm bin entry's executable bit.
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && rolldown -c rolldown.config.ts && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.//prepack: Local safety net only. The repo-wide .npmrc sets ignore-scripts=true, which disables this hook, so CI/release must build explicitly before publishing (see .github/workflows/release.yml). It fires only for a publish run with lifecycle scripts enabled.

author: John L. Armstrong IV
